title: Planning applications in England
description: Quarterly planning applications, decisions, grants, refusals, processing times and enforcement activity reported by local planning authorities in England.
publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

files.note: PS1 district planning matters: applications at the start and end of each quarter, applications received, decided and withdrawn, plus enforcement and permitted-development activity. Full historical local planning authority dataset.
PS2 district planning matters: decisions, grants, refusals and decision times by development type and local planning authority. Full historical local planning authority dataset.
